Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Class BulkPublicationAdminController

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.BulkPublicationAdminController
@RestController @Conditional(org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk.BulkPublicationAdminController.AutoConfiguredOnlyCondition.class) @RequestMapping("${praxis.bulk.lifecycle.admin-endpoints.base-path:/api/platform/bulk-operations/publication}") public class BulkPublicationAdminController extends Object
Opt-in HTTP administration endpoints for asynchronous bulk publication/reconciliation jobs and V21 durable lifecycle audit queries. Enabled when praxis.bulk.lifecycle.admin-endpoints.enabled=true.
